speakers.name: Grand Marshal Aurelia Vane
speakers.comment: Neutral ground is the hardest position on any map and this one has held for decades without a garrison. Whoever keeps that bar keeps it by never once picking a side. I have lost bridges defending less.

items.title: I'm a Sea Anemone and I WILL Take Over the World

speakers.name: Glorp the Zookeeper
speakers.comment: Psychic anemone, one dugong, total world domination — okay, professionally, the assistant is doing all the load-bearing work here and nobody has told him, and I have SEEN this exact staffing structure and it ends with somebody crying in the kelp.

speakers.name: Tobias the Rookie God
speakers.comment: He's running for office and everyone seems fine about it, which is — is that fine? Nobody asked whether he'd be good at it, they asked whether he could win, and I have thunder I'm afraid to use and he has a slogan.

speakers.name: Mr. Fairweather
speakers.comment: What a room! Everybody here is about to be either very rich or very gone, and the trick, friend, is to be standing beside the first sort at precisely the moment it becomes obvious which is which. Let me get this round.

speakers.name: Zuzu
speakers.comment: A town with a secret worth killing for, and a young samurai who has followed me here to end it. Both of those are true and neither is urgent. Sunset is hours off. Sit down. Eat something first.

items.title: I Am a New Intern and I Will Shatter the Glass Ceiling with My Feminist Dialectic and Giant Sledgehammer

speakers.name: The Backpack Pigeon
speakers.comment: Counsel advises that a sledgehammer is admissible if the ceiling is load-bearing and the ceiling is metaphorical, and further advises that OverCorp's legal department bills at double my rate. Swing anyway. I'll file from the lobby.

items.title: Why Do People Keep Attacking My Dungeon?

speakers.name: Grenidan
speakers.comment: Because the sign says dungeon. That's it. That's the answer. I have explained to eleven separate parties that the slimes are staff and the treasure is payroll, and every one of them said they understood and then rolled for initiative.

speakers.name: The Cubit
speakers.comment: One human among cephalopods and every measurement in the building calibrated for eight arms. Nobody has thought about the desks. Nobody ever thinks about the desks. I raise it because somebody must and it will not be the shark.

items.title: It's My Birthday So I Kidnapped a Princess and Today We're Getting Married

speakers.name: Vexa Thornes
speakers.comment: MAGNIFICENT. Bold, romantic, a lava moat — and — hm. And you have not asked her a single question, have you. I did this. I did exactly this. The monologue is superb and the third act is a very long conversation.

speakers.name: The Question Mark
speakers.comment: Telepathic squids, gravity-defiant giraffes, and a rota that changes hourly — ooh, nothing in this building has SETTLED, nothing has decided what it is yet! Do not label the enclosures. Label nothing. Let it stay open!

speakers.name: The Tortoise of the Tea Shop
speakers.comment: A skeletal kitten needs the same thing a living one needs, dear: somebody who remembers what it liked. Steep the customer a cup before they choose. The ones who come in certain always take home the wrong companion.

speakers.name: Quill the Convenience Clerk
speakers.comment: Welcome in. Potions are aisle two, the polish is behind the counter because of the dragon, and yes the broom closet is enchanted and no you may not look. Same voice for the paladin and the lich. That's the whole job.

items.title: My Boss is a Gorgon: Greek Mythology Personal Assistant Simulator

speakers.name: The Caretaker of the Living Soil
speakers.comment: Sorry — I only wanted to say that everyone talks about the stare and nobody talks about the calendar. She has been managed badly for centuries by people frightened of her. Manage her well and I think the stare stops being the story.

items.title: I'm a 200-Foot Kaiju and I'm Hungry

speakers.name: The Kaiju Who Just Wants to Sit Down
speakers.comment: ...You are hungry and they keep interrupting. ...I know. ...I want to tell you something that took me four hundred years. ...The buffet is not the problem. ...You have been awake nine hours and nobody has offered you anywhere to put yourself down.

speakers.name: Tobias the Rookie God
speakers.comment: Brand new and they hand you a sandbox and a complaints department, which is — that's the part they undersell, isn't it. Do the miracles small at first. Very small. Nobody warns you that a large one is impossible to take back.

items.title: Madame Luxoria's Super Deathtrap Dungeon of Ultimate Fatal Destiny

speakers.name: Mx. Eleven-Fingers
speakers.comment: One. Two. Three traps in the first corridor and all three announced in advance — she is a showman, and I salute her, and I would gently note that a trap you can see is a trap that is counting on you feeling clever.

speakers.name: Margin
speakers.comment: The rabbit offers to help in the middle of the frame. Watch the edges instead. Whatever is standing just outside the panel has been there in every scene, and it is not drawn, and it is not gone.

speakers.name: The Frequency
speakers.comment: home dot exe, sweetheart. Say it again. Say it the way it wants to be said. Three factions are chasing a file that is only valuable because everybody agreed it was, and agreement is my entire native tongue.

speakers.name: The Iron Pacific
speakers.comment: THE DRAGON POSTED ITS OWN BOUNTY! WHOO-EEE! That ain't a warrant, partner, that's an INVITATION, and out here the only creatures who write their own paper are the ones fixin' to be caught on purpose. Ride careful. Ride LOUD.

items.title: Chrono Nexus: The Collapse of Time

speakers.name: The Soldier Out of Time
speakers.comment: Three of you shouting and one working device. I have stood in that formation before, in a different century, with a different thing in my hand. Assign one voice. Not the loudest — the one who has been quiet and is still here.

items.title: Abyssal Awakening: Secrets of the Sunken World

speakers.name: Threshold
speakers.comment: She is not mapping. She is returning. You are not admitted to what waits at forty thousand feet and neither is she, and the difference between you is that she has stopped asking. Surface. That is the whole verdict.

speakers.name: Brine
speakers.comment: You sat down! You just SAT DOWN and now there's a nebula and someone's doing the safety talk in your pyjamas — sorry, YOU'RE in the pyjamas — and honestly? Honestly this is the most relatable disaster I have ever read, I love it, keep going.

items.title: Paws for Thought: The Curious Case of the Talking Tabby

speakers.name: The Generous Ghost
speakers.comment: Oh, the poor things, none of them trusting each other — let me help, let me just sit in on the interviews and pour and tidy and remind everyone what they said. You needn't solve it alone, dear. You needn't do any of it alone.

speakers.name: Chef Bellamy Crisp
speakers.comment: Viking feast, burnt boar, insulted war-chief. Right. Skim the fat, salt harder than feels correct, and send it out before he finishes the sentence. Talk yourself through it aloud. The century is not the variable. The heat is.
